flags.why: This name for black sesame soup is used mainly in Southern Vietnamese, especially around Saigon–Chợ Lớn ([source](https://afamily.vn/che-hoa-o-sai-gon-20220820092205931.chn)).
This is a formal term typically used for respected patriotic or historical figures ([dictionary](https://vdict.com/ch%C3%AD%20s%C4%A9%2C3%2C0%2C0.html?lang=vi)).
The broader taxonomic usage refers to the traditional thrush group Turdidae, rather than any Old World flycatcher ([source](https://vjs.ac.vn/vjbio/article/download/5456/5020/19785)).
flags.fix: a bird of the traditional thrush group (Turdidae in older classifications)

flags.why: The older naming sense means identifying someone explicitly by name, rather than a thing's proper name ([dictionary](https://tudientv.com/?t=ch%C3%ADnh+danh)).
flags.fix: Gloss: by name; explicitly identifying the person concerned; tags: dated; example: Bài báo nêu chính danh ông giám đốc. = The article names the director explicitly.
